channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Easkey battle past Ballinasloe to Connacht club JHC four-in-a-row
item.description: Easkey (Sligo) are Connacht club junior hurling champions for the fourth year in-a-row after edging out Ballinasloe (Galway) by 2-17 to 2-15 at the Connacht GAA Centre of Excellence in Bekan this afternoon.

item.title: Camogie: Wall double steers 'Barr's to first Munster senior title
item.description: A return of 2-4 from Kate Wall including a dramatic late winner proved pivotal as St Finbarr's saw off a determined De La Salle to secure a first AIB Munster Senior Club Camogie Championship title.

item.title: Four-goal Kilcoo see off Erne Gaels for another Ulster club SFC final berth
item.description: Kilcoo cruised into another Ulster club senior football championship final with a 4-12 to 1-10 win over Erne Gaels Belleek at the Box-It Athletic Grounds this afternoon.

item.title: Dingle crush Mungret St Pauls for Munster club SFC final spot
item.description: Kerry champions Dingle had it all their own way as they blew Limerick counterparts Mungret St Pauls away with a 2-15 to 0-2 victory in Tralee to move into the Munster club senior football championship final.

item.title: St Martin's into first Leinster club SHC final after 10-point win over Naas
item.description: St Martin's booked their place into the Leinster club senior hurling championship final against Ballyhale Shamrocks thanks to a 0-21 to 0-11 win against Naas at Chadwicks Wexford Park this afternoon.

item.title: Ballyhale battle past Clough Ballacolla to third Leinster club SHC final in five years
item.description: Kilkenny kingpins Ballyhale Shamrocks stayed on course for a 13th Leinster club SHC title after edging out Clough Ballacolla on a 1-18 to 1-15 scoreline at UPMC Nowlan Park this afternoon.

item.title: Strokestown hit Kilmeena for four goals to claim maiden Connacht title
item.description: Strokestown (Roscommon) are Connacht club intermediate football champions after recording a 4-11 to 0-14 win against Kilmeena (Mayo) at Hastings Insurance MacHale Park this afternoon.

item.title: Watch: Hayes hat-trick sends Barrs towards Munster club SFC final date with Dingle
item.description: St Finbarr's will meet Dingle in the Munster club senior football championship final after brushing aside Éire Óg Ennis at SuperValu Pairc Ui Chaoimh this afternoon.

item.title: Newbridge-Scotstown Ulster semi-final abandoned after half-time pitch inspection
item.description: This afternoon's Ulster club SFC semi-final between Newbridge (Derry) and Scotstown (Monaghan) at O'Neills Healy Park has been abandoned at half-time due to adverse weather conditions.
